This magnet won't give you a boost of power or torque it merely raises the electronic rev limiter so high that the vehicle will never reach it. Detach the connector from the strap after every use and rinse the strap under running water. Hang the strap to dry. When needed, hand wash the strap gently with a mild soap and water solution.
